summary: Backcountry skier fell ~2 miles up the Cathedral Lake Trail southwest of Aspen, critically injured and unresponsive; Mountain Rescue Aspen ground teams plus a HAATS helicopter responded, hoisting the skier ~3:00 p.m. to Aspen-Pitkin County Airport, then Aspen Ambulance to Aspen Valley Hospital.
location: Cathedral Lake Trail (~2 miles up), southwest of Aspen
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen / Pitkin County Sheriff's Office (HAATS, Aspen Ambulance assisted)
notes: Content-farm reprint of the Pitkin County Sheriff's Office press release (machine-translated); incident details consistent across three site pages quoting the same release. 2022-05-21 = Saturday.
